<thought>We need SMILES for all possible linked fragments of the sample's molecule. The tool `return_possible_fragments` is designed to return a list of fragments of the sample by removing one or two atoms. Calling this tool should give us the required SMILES fragments directly without needing to deduce the full structure.</thought>
<action>return_possible_fragments</action>
